title: Why Some People Can't Fall Asleep Without the TV On
title_options: Why Some People Can't Fall Asleep Without the TV On
Why Your Brain Wants the TV On at Night
Sleeping With the TV On: What It Does to Your Brain
seo_intro:
Why do some people need the TV on to fall asleep? In silence, the brain's default mode network replays worries; a familiar show fills working memory, takes the pressure off, and feels like company.
We look at the science (Harvard, Stanford, Northwestern, NIH), what the TV's light and noise do while you sleep, and 5 research-backed ways to sleep better.
